cards.reporter_found: Elsewhere, Jack Strand still did not receive team work, but he is expected to play half of Saturday’s preseason game. Chris Blair received most of Jahan Dotson’s first-team snaps during red-zone work, giving him another opportunity to make his case for a roster spot.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: Chris Blair took most of Jahan Dotson's first-team red-zone snaps during one joint practice. The report does not say why those snaps were available or for how long, and it does not establish that Blair has moved ahead of Dotson.
cards.author: Darius Hayes

cards.reporter_found: DeVonta Smith returned to practice in a limited capacity Thursday. The Eagles listed him as limited with a hamstring injury. A day earlier, he participated in individual drills but did not take part in 11-on-11 work.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: Smith's return is a positive step for his availability, but limited practice work does not establish that he is ready for full team periods or game action. No timetable was reported, so this does not change his projection.
cards.author: Jimmy Kempski

cards.reporter_found: Sam LaPorta did not participate in practice. The report did not provide a reason for his absence.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: LaPorta's absence is worth noting, but one unexplained missed practice does not establish an injury or a continuing availability concern. No timetable or additional context was reported, so this does not change his projection.
cards.author: John Maakaron

cards.reporter_found: The Eagles officially listed Makai Lemon as a non-participant with a hamstring injury. Although he was not in uniform, he was observed taking part in some receiver drills.
cards.lineupbeat_impact: Lemon's non-participant designation is a negative availability signal, although his receiver-drill work shows that he was not completely inactive. The evidence does not establish when he will resume full practice work, so this does not change his projection.
cards.author: Jimmy Kempski
